item.title: GTM Lead
item.description: We’re looking for a sales-driven GTM Lead to own go-to-market across two related but distinct motions: HuSig, our full-service data/AI/analytics team working with international technology partners, and Closr, HuSig’s own product — a purpose-built CRM and LPMAMA lead-scoring engine built for independent real estate agents, currently in early pilot. This is not a build-the-pipeline-with-code role. You’ll be the person closing deals for HuSig’s services pipeline and personally pitching Closr — the CRM itself — into its first cohort of real estate agents, while owning our LinkedIn presence for both.
